evidence.detail: normalize_colors() finds 'Monou' as a color word (regex matches 'mono' prefix + 'u' suffix at end of word), and 'Simic' as another color word; their canonical color is Simic (GU); 'Monou' is found first so it is replaced by 'Simic' at its location (end of string), then the original 'Simic' at the start is removed via replace('Simic','',1)
is_true_match('Monou') returns True because 'Monou' contains non-WUBRG chars; standardize_color_string strips 'mono' leaving 'u' which maps to Blue, so Monou+Simic=Simic canonical color
normalize() calls normalize_colors on any name not matching an abbreviation, whitelist, or archetype name — no special handling for descriptive sentences

triage.notes: Root cause: regex_pattern for '[WUBRG]+' matches 'Monou' because 'mono' is an optional prefix in the pattern and 'u' is the final character; is_true_match passes because the word has non-WUBRG chars. Any fix must either restrict mono-prefixed color matching to whole-word-only tokens or skip color normalization when multiple color words appear in sentence-like context — both require rethinking the normalization algorithm.
